==Hero Usage==
Heroes will use this skill on recharge to remove conditions for any ally in [[earshot]] range even if that ally is already under the effects of the speed buff.

==Notes==
{{anomaly|If a condition is removed, [[Leadership]] will restore energy as if it affected two targets, requiring minimum 8 Leadership to receive the doubled benefit. This causes it to have a net cost of 1 energy.}}

== Trivia ==
*"It's just a flesh wound." is a reference to the movie [[w:Monty_Python_and_the_Holy_Grail|Monty Python and the Holy Grail]], in which the [[w:Black_Knight_(Monty_Python)|Black Knight]] makes this declaration after having his arms cut off. Additionally, the character in the [[skill icon]] is missing an arm.
*This is one of the two [[Skill pin]]s that were given out with the [[Guild Wars Nightfall#Guild Wars Nightfall Collector's Edition (box content)|Guild Wars Nightfall Collector's Edition]]; the other was [[Vow of Silence]].
*The figure in the skill icon is wearing [[Paragon Sunspear armor|Sunspear]] armor.
